sources.author: Harrison Chase
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO @ LangChain
sources.post_summary: Discussed the rapid evolution of AI agents from simple chains to autonomous multi-step systems. Highlighted how LangGraph enables developers to build reliable agent workflows with state management and human-in-the-loop capabilities.

sources.author: Sarah Guo
sources.headline: Founder @ Conviction
sources.post_summary: Shared insights on the emerging AI infrastructure stack, noting that 2025 will see consolidation around vector databases, evaluation frameworks, and production monitoring tools. Emphasized the shift from experimentation to reliable deployment.

sources.author: Simon Willison
sources.headline: Independent AI researcher & creator of Datasette
sources.post_summary: Posted about new local LLM tooling that enables developers to run powerful models entirely offline. Covered practical automation use cases including code generation and data processing without cloud dependencies.

sources.author: Raluca Ada Popa
sources.headline: Professor @ UC Berkeley & Co-founder @ Opaque Systems
sources.post_summary: Discussed secure AI infrastructure for enterprise, focusing on confidential computing approaches that allow organizations to run AI agents on sensitive data without exposing it. Covered real deployment patterns from recent pilots.

sources.author: Elena Voss
sources.headline: Head of GTM Engineering @ Ramp
sources.post_summary: Discussed building a unified GTM data model that connects marketing, sales, and CS systems into a single source of truth. Shared how their team reduced lead-to-opportunity handoff time by 40% through automated enrichment and routing rules.

sources.author: Marcus Hale
sources.headline: Founder & CEO @ OutboundOS
sources.post_summary: Explained how his team uses AI-driven intent signals to trigger personalized outbound sequences at scale. Highlighted a 3x increase in reply rates by layering buying signals with automated multi-channel outreach.

sources.author: Priya Sharma
sources.headline: VP Revenue Operations @ Notion
sources.post_summary: Broke down their quarterly GTM planning process, including how they align content calendars with sales plays and pipeline targets. Emphasized the importance of treating content as a revenue asset with measurable attribution.

sources.author: David Kwon
sources.headline: Director of Sales Operations @ Deel
sources.post_summary: Shared a framework for operationalizing outbound at scale, including ICP scoring models and automated sequence testing. Noted how their ops team cut manual SDR work by 60% through smart automation.

sources.author: Rachel Patel
sources.headline: GTM Strategist & Former Head of Content @ Webflow
sources.post_summary: Explored the intersection of content strategy and revenue operations, showing how mapping content assets to specific funnel stages improved SQL conversion by 28%. Advocated for tighter collaboration between content and sales teams.

sources.author: Daniel Vassallo
sources.headline: Independent maker & author | Ex-Amazon
sources.post_summary: Shared the full journey of building and launching a new micro-SaaS product solo, including the tech stack, pricing experiments, and first paying customers within 10 days of launch. Emphasized the value of shipping imperfect products fast and iterating based on real user feedback.

sources.author: Pieter Levels
sources.headline: Founder @ Nomad List & Remote OK
sources.post_summary: Posted about shipping a new AI-powered travel tool in one weekend as a solo founder. Broke down the product decisions, tech choices, and how he validated demand before writing code. Highlighted the freedom and speed of building alone without a team.

sources.author: Danny Postma
sources.headline: Founder @ Headlime & 10xAlt
sources.post_summary: Detailed his transition from marketing to full-time indie maker, including the first product he built after quitting his job. Shared revenue numbers from month one and lessons on choosing ideas that solve painful problems for a specific audience.

sources.author: Arvid Kahl
sources.headline: Author of Zero to Sold | Ex-FeedbackPanda
sources.post_summary: Wrote about the emotional side of pivoting from a bootstrapped SaaS exit into a new solo project. Discussed how he chose the next idea, set constraints around time and scope, and why public accountability helps him stay consistent while building.

sources.author: Marc Lou
sources.headline: Solo founder @ ShipFast & MicroAcquire
sources.post_summary: Shared his weekly build log of a new open-source starter kit for indie hackers. Included metrics on GitHub stars, early user signups, and how he uses Twitter + LinkedIn to gather feedback while shipping in public.
